desc: Ideation: derive the two-chain reduction and the dominance DP state.
Implement chain assignment, `u`/`h` computation, and deterministic sorting.
Implement `can(d)` with the dominance DP, activation heaps, and Fenwick/segment-tree height queries.
Add binary search over the answer and integrate with the starter class.
Validate on the provided samples and on small random brute-force cases.
